Name: Experience Config
Author: melodyhalftone
Description:
[size=5][b][u]What is this:[/u]
[/b][/size]
A simple mod that adds experience sliders for both vanilla skills and custom skilled implemented with SpaceCore. This mod will also track any fractional experience and award them to the player if they gain additional experience.

For example: Assuming you are getting 5 experience in a skill and you are using 0.5 multiplier for that skill. You will get 2 experience instead, but the 0.5 leftover is still being tracked, and if you get 5 experience in the same skill again. You will instead get 3 experience since 5/2 + 0.5 = 3.

[size=5][b][u]Installation:[/u][/b][/size]﻿
﻿1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
﻿2. Download and extract the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
﻿3. Done

[size=5][b][u]Compatibility:
[/u][/b][/size]Compatible with all custom [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] skills. One thing to note is that SpaceCore skills seems to be recognized only after you start or load into a game. This means that on a fresh installation, you may not see the SpaceCore skill sliders in the GenericModConfig settings on the main menu, but once you load into the game, the settings should be populated in the mod settings.

Also note that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/521?tab=files]Luck Skill[/url] is not a SpaceCore skill, but [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28103]Luck Skill[/url] is.

Compatible with profession overhaul mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of LIFE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url].

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22163]Share Experience[/url]: My multiplier will always apply first and the new experience amount will be distributed to other skills.

Should work in multiplayer but I didn't test it.


[b][size=5][u]F.A.Q.:[/u]
[/size][/b][size=2][i][b]Does this work on an existing save?[/b][/i][/size]
[list]
[*]Yes
[/list][i][b]I can't find SpaceCore skills under settings?[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Try loading into the game first and look at settings again.
[/list][i][b]Does this work with ____ Custom Skills?[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]If the Skill requires SpaceCore, most likely. If not, then no.
[/list][i][b]I want more than 50x multiplier for my skills?[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]I limited the slider to 50 in the Generic Mod Configs, but you can Always open the Config.json to edit it manually and change the number to whatever you want except negative numbers. The numbers for VanillaSkillMultiplier is in the order of "Farming", "Fishing", "Foraging", "Mining", and "Combat". And the numbers for SpaceCoreSkillMultipliers should have the name of the skill in front of it.
[/list][i][b]I'm getting ERRORS and it's not working![/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Please upload your SMAPI log along with a screenshot & description if possible. I will try to troubleshoot it when I have time.
[/list]
